dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive time series dataset of absolute reservoir storage in mainland southeast asia msea res from 1985 to 2023

description: The National University of Singapore and Cornell University publish MSEA-Res, ten-day estimates of absolute storage for major reservoirs in mainland Southeast Asia. The current record covers 186 reservoirs larger than 0.1 cubic kilometres over 1985–2023, with approximately 175 cubic kilometres of combined capacity. Water areas derived from Landsat and Sentinel-2 are converted to storage through elevation-area-storage relationships using SRTM and reconstructed bathymetry where necessary. The open Zenodo record provides database and Python-code ZIP archives and describes maximum-extent Shapefiles. Reuse is free under CC-BY-4.0. Storage is inferred from imagery and bathymetric relationships; observation gaps and errors can propagate into the estimates. The coverage intentionally excludes smaller reservoirs. The series could calibrate regional reservoir balances or examine drought storage and inter-reservoir behaviour. They complement the asset locations in data-gdat-global-dam-tracker and the monitoring workflow in model-rat-reservoir-assessment-tool, subject to matching reservoir identities and time conventions.
